component.name: KVault
component.summary: Unofficial native client for Bitwarden servers

description.p: KVault is an unofficial Kirigami client for Bitwarden vaults. It speaks the Bitwarden API directly and decrypts everything locally with OpenSSL, so no browser engine and no JavaScript runtime is involved.

ul.li: All item types: logins, secure notes, cards, identities and SSH keys
Create, edit, delete and restore items, and organize them in folders
Time-based one-time password codes with a live countdown
An offline cache, so the vault stays readable without a network
Automatic locking when idle, and clipboard entries that clear themselves

description.p: Your master password is never stored and never leaves the device. It is used locally to derive the keys that decrypt the vault; only a one-way hash of it is sent to the server. Session tokens are kept in your wallet rather than on disk.

KVault is an independent project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Bitwarden, Inc. "Bitwarden" is a trademark of Bitwarden, Inc., referred to here only to describe the service this client interoperates with.

description.p: Add native aarch64 builds for Arch, Debian, RPM, and Flatpak packages.
Fix the Fedora package missing the "org.kde.desktop" QQC2 style module and the Debian package missing the SVG imageformats plugin, either of which made the app fail to start.
Add native Debian and RPM release packages.
